description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between reliability score and cost for three different models: the 3-Model Ensemble, the 2-Model Ensemble, and GPT-4. The x-axis, labeled "Cost," ranges from 0 to 10 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis, labeled "Reliability Score," ranges from 30 to 90, also on a linear scale, with major gridlines at intervals of 20. The 3-Model Ensemble, represented by a blue line with circular markers, starts at a reliability score of approximately 80 when the cost is 0 and decreases to about 73 at a cost of 10. The 2-Model Ensemble, shown as a red line with circular markers, begins at a reliability score of approximately 82 at a cost of 0 and declines to around 72 at a cost of 10. The GPT-4 model, depicted by a yellow line with circular markers, starts at a reliability score of approximately 89 at a cost of 0 and shows a steep decline, reaching a score of about 35 at a cost of 10. All three lines exhibit a downward trend, indicating that reliability score decreases as cost increases.
